lemma nat_pow3_le_pow3 (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 1) : (n : ℕ) ^ 3 ≤ 3 ^ n := by
  induction' hn with k hk IH
  · norm_num -- n = 1
  · cases k with
    | zero => contradiction -- k >= 1
    | succ k' =>
      cases k' with
      | zero => norm_num -- n = 2
      | succ k'' =>
        cases k'' with
        | zero => norm_num -- n = 3
        | succ k''' =>
          simp_all [pow_succ, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib]
          ring_nf at *
          nlinarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℕ) < 3) k''']

  · have hn_pos : (n : ℝ) > 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h

lemma nat_pow3_le_pow3 (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 1) : (n : ℕ) ^ 3 ≤ 3 ^ n := by
  induction' hn with k hk IH
  · norm_num -- n = 1
  · cases k with
    | zero => contradiction -- k >= 1
    | succ k' =>
      cases k' with
      | zero => norm_num -- n = 2
      | succ k'' =>
        cases k'' with
        | zero => norm_num -- n = 3
        | succ k''' =>
          simp_all [pow_succ]
          ring_nf at *
          nlinarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℕ) < 3) k''']

  (n : ℕ) :

  · have hn_pos : (n : ℝ) > 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h
    have hn_ge_one : (n : ℕ) ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h
    have hn_ge_one_real : (n : ℝ) ≥ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hn_ge_one

    · subst hn1
      norm_num
    · have hn_ge_two : n ≥ 2 := by
        by_contra h2
        have h1 : n = 1 := by omega
        contradiction
      
      -- Prove n^3 <= 3^n
      have h_n3_le_3n : (n : ℕ) ^ 3 ≤ 3 ^ n := by
        apply nat_pow3_le_pow3 _ hn_ge_one
      have h_n3_le_3n_real : (n : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ n := by
        exact_mod_cast h_n3_le_3n

              _ = ((n : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ (1 / (3 * n : ℝ)) := by
